d: Long, flowing champagne-blonde hair with thick, curling locks cascades down the back, complemented by straight bangs across the forehead. The golden-amber eyes are narrow and sharp, set in a youthful, mature face. A slender build is dressed in a dark navy military jacket with silver epaulettes, silver chains, a black belt, and a teal-lined black cape draped over one shoulder, paired with white leggings and knee-high black lace-up boots. A black military shako hat with silver detailing sits atop the head, and white gloves cover the hands.
